notes: bit_scramble and bit_descramble, polynomial 1 + x^-18 + x^-23 over symbols of 1 bits (delays 23 and 18 bits): input are 4096 soft bits of random sign and magnitude 0.05 to 2 (bit 100 is 0, bit 1000 is -0), scrambled is bit_scramble of input (s[n] = x[n] ^ s[n - A] ^ s[n - B], the register holds the bits sent), descrambled is bit_descramble of input (y[n] = r[n] ^ r[n - A] ^ r[n - B], the register holds the bits received); the output is the input with its sign flipped where the parity is 1, a bit is 1 when the value is above 0; one-bit-at-a-time model of the register, zero at the start; exact
